resourceScope: Per model pod scheduling reservation, including init containers. additionalWorkloads lists separate per-node pods. Shared gateway, operator and Pylon resources are additional.
memoryAccounting: Unified-memory profiles use one shared host/GPU memory pool. Do not add a separate GPU memory allocation.
placement: Choose an eligible profile and supply distinct compatible nodes with exclusive available GPUs.

recipes.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
recipes.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash is a mixture-of-experts language model with 284 billion parameters, 13 billion active per token, and support for up to 1 million tokens of context. This recipe serves it with FP4 expert weights across two DGX Spark nodes joined by a 200 Gbps link, or across two DGX Station nodes, with an 8,192-token context.

automaticHelmWorkload.reason: Gateway verification of the existing Helm deployment of this profile passed readiness, registration, discovery, chat, streaming and authentication with model-default thinking and server-default output and sampling settings. Chat and streaming finished with stop and the model pods had no restarts. Context-boundary, lifecycle and fabric checks have not been repeated with these defaults.

recipes.name: GLM-5.3
recipes.description: GLM-5.3 is a 754 billion parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Z.ai. This card serves Unsloth's UD-IQ2_M 2-bit GGUF quantization, about 239 GB of weights, with llama.cpp. It runs on three DGX Sparks, one leader and two RPC workers, at a 2,048-token context, or on two DGX Station nodes at an 8,192-token context.

validation.scope: The combined two-GB10 deployment passed inference and worker recovery. Automatic Helm trials on 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-12 passed qualification and weight verification, then stopped at the host-memory guard during model loading. The 2026-10-12 trials at tensor splits 50/50, 52/48 and 51/49 each ended with under 1 GiB of host memory available on one node, below the 1 GiB floor. The guard was left unchanged.

Three-GB10 layer split of the pinned checkpoint, with one leader and two RPC workers. On 2026-10-12 the automatic Helm install passed placement, three-GPU distributed qualification, runtime and model integrity, readiness, gateway discovery, chat, streaming and authentication at context 2,048 and concurrency 1. Each node held about 74 GiB of weights and kept at least 33 GiB of host memory available, so the 1 GiB host-memory guard did not trigger. Stop/resume, longer context, throughput and output quality are untested. The two-node profile stopped at the host-memory guard.

otherModelIsolation.reason: This profile uses both available GPUs. Shared CPU services were checked while the model was stopped.

recipes.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
recipes.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30 billion parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 3 billion parameters per token. It combines Mamba-2, mixture-of-experts and attention layers and supports up to 1 million tokens of context. This recipe serves the NVFP4 build on one DGX Spark, with up to 16,384 tokens of context, or on one DGX Station, with up to 8,192 tokens, with reasoning and tool-call parsing enabled.

automaticHelmWorkload.reason: Packaged Helm upgrade passed readiness, registration, discovery, chat, streaming and authentication with model-default thinking and server-default output and sampling settings. All three generated responses finished with stop and included final answers. Retained verified weights were reused and cache identities were preserved. Context-boundary and lifecycle checks have not been repeated with these generation defaults.

resolvedFailures.observed: Initial startup rejected a retained cache marker containing the previous nemotron3.5-lightning recipe ID.
resolvedFailures.fix: All retained checkpoint blobs passed verification before the marker recipe ID was migrated to nemotron-3.5-lightning. Repository and model revision were unchanged. A fresh serving pod then passed readiness and inference with zero restarts.

recipes.name: Nemotron Nano 12B v2
recipes.description: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 12B v2 is a 12.3 billion parameter hybrid language model built mostly from Mamba-2 and MLP layers with only six attention layers, and it supports up to 131,072 tokens of context. This recipe serves the BF16 build on one DGX Spark, with up to 16,384 tokens of context, or on one DGX Station, with up to 8,192 tokens.

automaticHelmWorkload.reason: Packaged Helm deployment passed readiness, registration, discovery, ordinary chat, streaming and authentication. Explicit /no_think plus enable_thinking=false passed an 8160-token prompt with up to 32 output tokens. Stop/resume and uninstall/reinstall reused the original verified cache, restored discovery and inference, and preserved the original model availability.

resolvedFailures.fix: Disable overlap scheduling for the no_buffer cache strategy.
Use the toggle-aware qwen3 reasoning parser. Non-thinking calls pair the checkpoint /no_think marker with enable_thinking=false.
Use the native non-mmap loader, reading one shard at a time. Hardware and host/device memory checks remain enabled.

resolvedFailures.failure: Repeated HTTP 502 from UDP GSO packet loss across the pod overlay. Direct backend HTTP succeeded.
resolvedFailures.fix: Shared router and Pylon use STARGATE_QUIC_DISABLE_GSO=true through their Helm values. Verified over a cross-node tunnel.
